Avery preparation survived navigation while Jordan loaded; the rendered confirmation flow and direct public:confirm-wishlist dispatch left an Avery synthetic URL on Demo Jordan. reproduction.smallest_supported_fix_proposal: Bind wishlist intent/destination/confirmation to the profile identity at preparation, then only render or dispatch confirmation/continue for that same identity. On profile change, invalidate or require a fresh explicit preparation for the newly displayed profile; preserve the captured-reference renderer's separate static-link priority and user-controlled synthetic URL behavior. Regression should assert both stale control hidden/rejected and re-preparation selects the current profile's synthetic URL.

limitations: This is a deterministic volatile fixture reproduction, not a browser click/visual QA or live external handoff.
No source/test edits or repair were performed; this is only the initial read-only evidence packet.
